decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so it can interpret early results and refine the product through its existing application and service expertise.

UV spot varnishing is distant from the firm's established knowledge base, which limits its ability to assimilate and exploit it, but it is a flagship with a quantified premiere event and partner backing from Duplo, so it is kept for now.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's modular finishing systems, so absorptive capacity is high and it complements the rest of the portfolio.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship close to the firm's core competence in multifinishing and fits its direction toward automated workflows, so it is retained.
The hybrid saddle stitcher extends the firm's long-standing booklet-making expertise, which lets it learn from customer feedback and improve the product effectively.
The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and already has a documented customer installation running in one pass, which gives the firm interpretable results to build on.
